description: This file defines an interface 'ICachePressureMonitor' in the Orleans.Streaming.EventHubs namespace. The interface is used for monitoring cache pressure, including recording contributions and determining if the cache is under pressure based on a back pressure algorithm.

classes.name: ICachePressureMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring cache pressure, including recording pressure contributions and checking if under pressure, with a property for related cache metrics.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a cache pressure contribution value.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Checks if the cache is under pressure at the given UTC time.
